_comment: Skeleton plan for the canonical Deed flow — the SHAPE to hand to manage-flow.
DO NOT hand-write a real flow from this. Route authoring to manage-flow (control C13).
This file exists so the handoff asks for the right thing and can be checked afterwards.
claim/submit MUST be unreachable without an approved bid/evaluate.
Bid approval is what grants SubmitClaimAuthorization. A flow that lets a youth
claim without it sends them to do work whose proof will be rejected on chain —
after they have already done it.
Use "" for strings and {} for objects that are configured later in the editor.
NEVER put a runtime-only field in nb. NEVER write concrete DIDs, addresses,
blueprint DIDs, contract addresses, or token configs at plan time — those are
CONFIRMATIONS: every side-effecting step keeps its confirmation requirement.
Never strip one to reduce friction.
BRANCHES: every branch must terminate with something the youth is TOLD.
A branch that silently ends is a young person left waiting.

capabilities.title: Set up claim rules
_stages: 1 preflight  READ-ONLY    revalidate → re-check against live form → engine pre-check
2 register   IRREVERSIBLE mint delegation, deposit UCAN, register collection, grant authz
3 publish    REPLACES     canonicalise → upload → anchor #rub → pin
capabilities._rule: A rules error must fail at stage 1, before any irreversible work. Never after.

capabilities.title: Review the application
capabilities._aud_must_be: in the controller set (owner, entity.controller[], or GenericAuthorization holder)
aud: <<<bid evaluator — verify they are in the controller set>>>

capabilities.title: Submit your proof
capabilities._CRITICAL: This condition is the authorization edge. Verify it explicitly at control C13.

capabilities.title: Check the proof
capabilities._determiner: per control C17 tier — low risk AND low value may settle automatically; medium or high escalates to a human; any safeguarding flag forces a human, always

capabilities.title: Pay the reward
capabilities._aud_must_be: whoever may release treasury funds, per control C2

_branches_that_must_terminate.bid_rejected: reason returned to the applicant + whether they may reapply + who to ask
_branches_that_must_terminate.bid_waitlisted: told they are waitlisted + what happens next + by when
_branches_that_must_terminate.claim_rejected: reason code in their language + the dispute path
_branches_that_must_terminate.claim_in_review: told it is in review + by when a decision comes
_branches_that_must_terminate.budget_exhausted: the control C16 on_exhaustion behaviour actually executes, and youth are told

_verify_at_gate_14: claim/submit is gated on evaluate-bid decision == approve
every branch above terminates with something the youth is told
no runtime-only field appears in any nb
no concrete DIDs, addresses, or token configs at plan time
every side-effecting step keeps its confirmation requirement
every aud holds the authority its step needs
event triggers only on eligible action types — confirm the set with manage-flow
the flow exists as a Template on the PROTOCOL so it imports at domain instantiation
